label: Kanban
blurb: The same nodes grouped by status. Drag between columns.

columns.doc: the columns, in order; any names, any count

readOnly.doc: agent-owned: every editing affordance is REMOVED, not disabled

heartbeat.doc: {by, at, phase: working|idle, note} — who is minding this tab, with age decay

controls.label: Add node
controls.doc: Add a card to the first column.

controls.title: move up
controls.doc: Reorder a card up within its column.

controls.title: move down
controls.doc: Reorder a card down within its column.

controls.title: delete (children move up a level)
controls.doc: Delete a card; its children reparent to its parent.

gestures: right-click for id, link, markdown, subtree
keys: move the selected card left / right
notes: Pair with a `dag` tab whose `stateFrom` points here to get both readings of one dataset.
A readOnly kanban still shows titles, notes, id chips and counts — only the controls go.
